meta.name: talking-head-recut
meta.description: Package an existing talking-head / interview / podcast video with timed, designed GRAPHIC OVERLAY cards — kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript, on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas of your choice; the clip plays untouched underneath. Trigger on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video". Not plain subtitles (/embedded-captions). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把访谈或播客视频叠加动态字卡与图文框,直接产出可发布成片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有一段访谈或播客录像,想快速加上设计好的动态字卡和图文框再发布。
copy.tagline_en: Overlay timed graphic cards and lower-thirds on your podcast or interview video.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have an interview video needing timed graphic overlays before publishing.

howto.what: 给它一段本地口播/访谈/播客视频,它会本地转录语音,设计按时间同步的图形卡片(标题、数据标注、引用、画中画等),为每张卡写 HTML,再合成渲染成 MP4;原视频画面不改动。
howto.when: 当你说 “graphic overlays”“on-screen graphics” 等,或要求给已有口播视频加图形包装时触发;普通字幕请走 /embedded-captions。

say.text: 给这个口播视频加上图形卡片包装,输出 9:16 的 MP4
say.note: 会转录、设计卡片并渲染出视频

say.text: 在视频开头做一张全屏标题卡,再配两张数据标注
say.note: 按时间点生成卡片 HTML 并合成

say.text: 把主题换成 noir,卡片最少做 5 张
say.note: 使用该主题配色与卡片节奏

howto.what_en: Give it a local talking-head, interview, or podcast video: it transcribes the speech, designs timed graphic cards (titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, PiP), writes each card's HTML, and renders an MP4; the clip itself plays untouched.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", or ask to package a talking-head video; plain subtitles go to /embedded-captions.

say_en.text: Package this talking-head video with graphic cards, output 9:16 MP4
Add a fullscreen title card at the start plus two data callouts
say_en.note: Writes card HTML timed to the transcript

say_en.text: Use the noir theme and at least 5 cards
say_en.note: Applies that theme's colors and pacing
